facts.text: The image is a character reference sheet labeled HERO, arranged as a collage: a wide hero panel at top; three full-body turnaround panels labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK; and four detail panels labeled FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.
The top HERO panel shows a lone person standing on a wet, rain-slicked urban walkway at night, with metal railings and dark city buildings behind.
The person has a lean build, shaved sides with a small topknot at the back, and a diagonal scar through one eyebrow.
The person wears a black high-collared jacket with straps and metal hardware, a black shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
In the HERO panel, the person stands facing generally forward with arms at their sides, head turned toward the left edge of the frame.

The FRONT panel shows the same person standing straight and facing the camera with arms relaxed at the sides; the SIDE PROFILE panel shows a left-facing profile; the BACK panel shows the rear of the outfit.
The FACE detail shows a close frontal view with a neutral, serious expression and a scar through one eyebrow; the JACKET COLLAR detail shows the high collar and a strap with metal hardware.
The HANDS detail shows two hands with prominent veins and textured skin; the BOOTS detail shows scuffed dark leather lace-up boots.
The top panel uses cool blue-gray night lighting with warm amber practical lights and wet reflections; the turnaround and detail panels use a plain dark gray backdrop and low-key soft lighting.
Visible text labels are HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS, all in white uppercase lettering.
